support: A grayscale starter brand guide for humans and agents — filled example copy you customize.
headline: Start with the Branding Exercise
body: If this kit is still a starter, run the Branding Exercise first (agent asks one question at a time, or share the written questionnaire). Prefer a website URL, brand PDF, or brand.md only when you already have source material — then skip intake and populate from that source. After fill, run npm run compile from guide/ and set status to "populated".

sources.label: Branding Exercise (recommended)
sources.detail: intake/brand-intake-questionnaire.md — agent asks one-by-one, or send as a written questionnaire.

sources.label: Website URL
sources.detail: Marketing site, product page, or About page your agent can read. Skips the questionnaire.

sources.label: Brand guide PDF
sources.detail: An existing PDF or deck — extract structure, voice, and visual rules. Skips the questionnaire.

sources.label: brand.md
sources.detail: A brand constitution file (this repo’s format — Strategy / Voice / Visual + Design system). Skips the questionnaire.

prompt: This brand-guide kit is still a starter (intake pending). Start with the Branding Exercise in intake/brand-intake-questionnaire.md: ask one question at a time, save answers to resources/transcripts/, set brand/setup.json intake to "complete", then rewrite brand.md (including Design system), examples.md, rules.md, and setup from the transcript. Run npm run compile from guide/. When done, set status to "populated". If I already have a URL / PDF / brand.md, set intake to "skipped" and follow intake/populate-from-source.md instead.
